### Hide and Seek { #awakening-hide-and-seek }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/doa/hide_and_seek.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Drags everyone in the zone into a sealed pocket dimension until the user lets them out or time runs out. When it ends everyone goes back to where they were.

### Living Gate { #awakening-living-gate }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/doa/living_gate.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

The user turns into a door, blocking physical attacks and swallowing incoming projectiles When the door closes it fires every projectile back at 1.5x speed where the user is looking.

### Backdoor { #awakening-backdoor }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/doa/backdoor.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Passive*

Door Door aimed at an enemy opens the door behind them instead of through a wall. The user's next blow on them within a few seconds opens a door in their body, dealing damage that ignores armor.
